base773hint_policy: Keep original reviewed cue in private evidence; deployment and monitor unchanged.

query_policy.ray: only_closest=True; hit and exact rigidBody only
query_policy.decision: all >=3 distinct samples for each occluded pending target; errors veto entire merge
query_policy.visible: current record result photos else current input photos; never historical union
query_policy.budget: existing monitor only; module has no action/budget/state writes
query_policy.pending_identity: stage matches live cfg benchmark/legacy identity; goal id/name/inside and resolved cfg part match live item id/name/container/part/joint/kind; no configured-only fallback
